notes.title: What happen the last few months!?
notes.content:
I, once again, have to apologize for lack of insight of what's been happening. The last few months has been a rollercoaster and I just haven't had the chance to chase up Kapivate and Kawaii_Puffin. I've finally able to chase up on them to get status ups.

First the art:
[list]
[*]The CG was put on hold by the artist for a bit due to living situations
[*]Currently the character illustrations bits for Yukari and Shiori CGs is finished
[*]Backgrounds is still in progress for the illustrations
[*]Emily and Saori's CG is sketched out
[/list]

For the script:
[list]
[*]Saori's route is about 30% done, which is the last route.
[*]Still need to go back through and touch up on the other routes and endings
[/list]

So the artwork is still slowly coming along, just unfortunately got delayed, and the script is still coming along. The script is getting closer to the finish line.

The project is still very much ongoing and hopefully get back on track soon.

I'll try to make sure I chase up on both Kap and Kawaii_Puffin on a near monthly bases if they don't poke me first to try to make sure you're all informed of current status.

notes.title: March 2023 Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

Just wanted to let everyone know about the progress. I'm about 50% done with writing Saori's route which is the last route I need to finish before moving on to the NSFW part of the game. I'm planning on releasing the game without the NSFW first and then have a patch come later down the line with it. 

We are a bit behind on art assets and because of that, once I'm done with writing, I'll be also drawing up some pieces for the game to help in that front as well.

Here is a quick breakdown of where I'm at with writing:

Common route: DONE
Yukari's route: DONE
Shiori's route: DONE
Emily's route: DONE (still need a bit of work but close)
Saori's route:
Written: 50%
QC: 20%
Implemented: 20%


Anyway, that's all from me, thanks again for all of your patience!

Eric

notes.title: Current State of the Game
notes.content:
Hey everyone. I'm sure you've all been wondering, "what the hell is happening to the game!?" and "why wasn't the game released in January?" or "Why was the game pushed back to next year?"

All valid questions and I'll try to sum up what I know of the current state of the game so far.

First of all the game is still being worked on, it's just slow since it's mainly just one person working on it. He got the majority of the routes in but is still waiting on art assets along with getting the other routes put in.

Second, the main and sole developer of the game had an issue with his computer that kept him from doing anything for a good while in late November to mid-December which slowed down his processed.

And, because of the fast approaching date and the game isn't anywhere near done to be submitted for review that it was decided to just set the ate for next year but aim to get it done a lot sooner.

Anyways, the lack of communication of the current state of the game is nobody but our own fault. I'm usually the one that pokes Eric (the sole developer of on the project) to post some sort of update which I didn't do the last few months and for that I'm sorry. All I can do is poke him for an update which I did and he said he'll post an update soon now that I've reminded him.

Got to remember that we're all human here, and when there's only one person that does everything makes it a lot tougher, and the fact that the holiday season was happening just put everything else on the back burner. But that's still no reason to not at least give you all an update of what's happening and we got to do better.

Anyways, if you have any questions, you are always welcome to come join the discord and ask there (you'll probably get a faster response there to be honest). You can join it at https://discord.gg/eQced4myDR

Keep an eye out for an update soon from the main developer
